IGUI_LCCQF_NPC_Alexey_Summary: A survivor you met at the old checkpoint route. More information will appear here as you learn it.
IGUI_LCCQF_NPC_Alexey_Fact_Met_Text: You met Alexey in person and can now recognize him and recall your conversations.
IGUI_LCCQF_NPC_Alexey_Fact_Checkpoint_Te: You completed Alexey's checkpoint job. It is now part of your personal history with him.
IGUI_LCCQF_NPC_Alexey_Fact_Supply_Text: You completed the roadside supply run for Alexey and remember how that work ended.
IGUI_LCCQF_Faction_CheckpointSurvivors_S: A small survivor group connected to the old checkpoint and the roads around it.
IGUI_LCCQF_Faction_CheckpointSurvivors_F: You learned that Alexey is connected to a survivor group operating around the old checkpoint.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_FactionResident_Start: You are inside our settlement. If you need something, say it plainly.
IGUI_LCCQF_Choice_FactionResident_Work: Is there work that needs doing?
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_FactionResident_Settle: This place is ours to keep alive. Beds, water, storage, food and people all matter more than the walls around them.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_FactionResident_Work: Work depends on what the settlement actually needs. If something is short, we will say so.
IGUI_LCCQF_Choice_FactionResident_Supply: What supplies are you short on?
About the supplies I am bringing...
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_FactionResident_Supply: Our stores are below the reserve we need. Put useful food directly into our settlement containers and the group will count what actually arrives.
Good. Use the settlement storage itself. The job only counts supplies that really reach our stores.
Keep supplying the settlement. Your journal will close the job only after your contribution is confirmed and the shortage is actually resolved.
IGUI_LCCQF_Status_UnknownNPCFromServer: The server returned an unknown NPC.
IGUI_LCCQF_Status_NoPermission: You do not have permission to spawn the test NPC.
IGUI_LCCQF_Status_SpawnFailed: Alexey could not be spawned. Check the server log.
IGUI_LCCQF_Status_AlreadyRegistered: Alexey is already registered; wait for the NPC to appear.
IGUI_LCCQF_Status_UnregisteredNPC: This NPC is not registered in Quest Framework.
IGUI_LCCQF_Status_NPCUnavailable: The NPC is not nearby or is no longer loaded.
IGUI_LCCQF_Status_DialogueTooFar: Dialogue closed because the NPC is no longer nearby.
IGUI_LCCQF_Status_ChoiceUnavailable: That response is not currently available.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_Start: You do not look local. If you came to talk, talk. I am not going anywhere yet.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_WorkOffer: I do have something. There is an old checkpoint not far from here. I will mark the place on your map. Reach it, look around, then come back to me.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_WorkAccepted: Good. The checkpoint is marked on your map. Reach the place, then return to me.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_WorkActive: The checkpoint is still waiting. Check your map, reach the marked place, then come back.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_SupplyOffer: There is another job. Thin out a few infected, find two sheets, clear the roadside point I mark, and bring the sheets back to me.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_SupplyAccepted: Start with the infected. After that find two sheets. The roadside point will be marked when it becomes relevant, then bring the sheets back to me.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_SupplyActive: Finish the current step. Your quest log has the exact objective and progress.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_SupplyCompleted: Good. The road is quieter and the supplies are here. That job is finished.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_Who: Call me Alexey. To the server I am a test NPC; to you I am the first person this system can talk through.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_Trust: You did what we agreed on. That is enough for a start. Keep it that way and I will have fewer reasons to doubt you.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_FactionMember: After what you have done for us, people here no longer see you as a stranger. That does not make you the owner of this place, but they will talk to you differently.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_AlignmentOffer: You have done enough to choose how you want to work with us. You can stand closer to the checkpoint and take responsibility for it, or keep more distance and work on your own terms.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_AlignmentSupportAccept: Then we will treat you as someone willing to carry part of the checkpoint's burden. Come back to me and we will make it clear.
IGUI_LCCQF_Dialog_AlignmentIndependentAc: Fair enough. Help when it makes sense, but keep your own line. Come back to me and we will settle it.
IGUI_LCCQF_Choice_AskTrust: We have worked together. Do you trust me?
IGUI_LCCQF_Choice_AskFactionMembership: So what does your group mean for me now?
IGUI_LCCQF_Choice_AcknowledgeFactionMemb: Understood. We will see where this leads.
IGUI_LCCQF_Choice_AskAlignment: What do you expect from me next?
IGUI_LCCQF_Choice_AlignmentSupport: I will stand with the checkpoint.
IGUI_LCCQF_Choice_AlignmentIndependent: I will work with you, but on my own terms.
IGUI_LCCQF_Quest_Checkpoint_Description: Alexey asked you to reach the old checkpoint marked on your world map and then return to him.
IGUI_LCCQF_Quest_SupplyRun_Description: Alexey wants the nearby infected reduced, two sheets collected, a roadside point cleared, and the supplies delivered back to him.
IGUI_LCCQF_Quest_BranchSupport_Descripti: You chose to stand closer to the checkpoint survivors and take a share of responsibility for the group. Speak with Alexey again to confirm the decision.
IGUI_LCCQF_Quest_BranchIndependent_Descr: You chose to keep working with the checkpoint survivors without giving up your independence. Speak with Alexey again to confirm the terms.
IGUI_LCCQF_Quest_SettlementSupply_Descri: A faction settlement is below its supply reserve. Deliver useful supplies directly into the settlement's real storage until the shortage is resolved.
IGUI_LCCQF_Quest_SettlementSupply_Object: Supply the settlement and resolve its shortage
